data.long_meaning: She who is gentle, peaceful, and content. It is a name that evokes images of gentleness, peace, and contentment - qualities that are highly valued in Islamic teachings. A name like Raeha can inspire those around her to be more mindful of their actions and words, and to strive for inner peace and tranquility.

It is a name that embodies the teachings of Islam, which emphasize the importance of seeking inner peace and submitting to the will of God. Those who bear this name may find themselves drawn to practices that promote spiritual growth and contemplation, and may find comfort and solace in the knowledge that they carry a name that reflects the noblest of human qualities.
